definitions.gloss: insurance money; insurance payout; insurance benefit
definitions.explanation: The money paid out by an insurance company when a claim is made, such as after an accident, illness, or death.

examples.japanese: {保険金|ほけんきん}を{請求|せいきゅう}した。
{事故|じこ}の{保険金|ほけんきん}がようやく{支払|しはら}われた。
examples.english: The insurance money for the accident was finally paid out.

examples.japanese: {生命|せいめい}{保険|ほけん}の{保険金|ほけんきん}{受取人|うけとりにん}を{変更|へんこう}する{手続|てつづ}きをした。
examples.english: I completed the procedure to change the beneficiary of the life insurance policy.

notes:
USAGE:
Distinguish from {保険料|ほけんりょう} (insurance premium), which is the amount paid by the policyholder. {保険金|ほけんきん} is the payout received from the insurance company.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保険金|ほけんきん}を{請求|せいきゅう}する (to file an insurance claim)
- {保険金|ほけんきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る (to receive insurance money)
- {保険金|ほけんきん}{受取人|うけとりにん} (insurance beneficiary)
- {保険金|ほけんきん}{詐欺|さぎ} (insurance fraud)
- {死亡|しぼう}{保険金|ほけんきん} (death benefit)
